failure_surface: PR #19 state-revision exact-member schema acceptance versus Stage 2 parse_immutable_ref semantic component decoding

oracles.title: state-revision membership still accepts percent triplets that are not valid UTF-8
oracles.contract_observation: PR #19 rejects percent-encoding of RFC3986-unreserved ASCII bytes and enforces true end-of-string, but still permits other uppercase percent triplets without proving that the resulting byte sequence decodes as UTF-8. %FF therefore satisfies the repaired component regex.
oracles.identity_observation: Stage 2 _decode_component converts percent triplets to bytes and decodes with strict UTF-8. A component containing byte FF raises UnicodeDecodeError and parse_immutable_ref rejects the reference.
oracles.pass_oracle: Every exact member reference accepted by state-revision.schema.json must decode successfully under the same strict UTF-8 semantics used by parse_immutable_ref, for both logical-id and version components.

oracles.title: state-revision membership still accepts valid UTF-8 components that are not NFC-canonical
oracles.contract_observation: The repaired regex accepts both %CC and %81 because neither triplet encodes an ASCII unreserved byte. Together they decode to the decomposed string e + U+0301.
oracles.identity_observation: Stage 2 _decode_component calls _assert_canonical_subset after UTF-8 decoding; non-NFC text is rejected. The decomposed e + U+0301 therefore fails even though the schema accepts its percent spelling. The NFC equivalent U+00E9 is canonically encoded as %C3%A9.
oracles.pass_oracle: Every exact member reference accepted by the state-revision contract must satisfy the Stage 2 NFC invariant unchanged for both logical-id and version components.

bounded_reproduction.method: Applied the exact PR #19 objective_ref regex to the counterexample strings and reproduced the relevant Stage 2 percent-byte decode plus NFC checks from axm_institution/identity.py.
results: %FF logical id: PR #19 regex accepted; strict UTF-8 decode rejected
%FF version: PR #19 regex accepted; strict UTF-8 decode rejected
e%CC%81 logical id: PR #19 regex accepted; UTF-8 decoded but NFC check rejected
e%CC%81 version: PR #19 regex accepted; UTF-8 decoded but NFC check rejected

observed_scope.adv029_repair: PR #19 source and tests directly repair the previously frozen unreserved-percent and trailing-data witnesses across all nine field families.
observed_scope.tested_head_to_final_head: Repository compare shows final PR #19 head differs from tested head only by the Lane 02 return packet file.
observed_scope.native_ci: GitHub Actions run 34724879851 concluded success on tested head 74fbe01970fa90fe9421006351bd1d95d14e6697; Lane 03 inspected this evidence but did not independently rerun the 62-test suite.
observed_scope.store_source: FilesystemObjectStore validates state-revision objects through the schema and explicitly does not parse/verify nested member references for closure. Because ADV-030 witnesses are schema-accepted ASCII strings, persistence through the normal store path is a source-grounded risk but was not independently runtime-executed in this activation.

root_implications.Truth: A contract must not label a string an exact canonical immutable reference when the canonical reference parser rejects that same string.
root_implications.Agency_non_domination: No occupant should need hidden cleanup or normalization rules to decide which spelling a supposedly exact reference meant.
root_implications.Continuity: Replacement occupants need one reconstructable reference language; schema-valid but parser-invalid member strings break that continuity boundary.
root_implications.Wisdom_before_speed: Hold only this exact canonical-language gate; do not pull relationship resolution or lifecycle runtime into the repair.

recommended_boundary: Keep PR #19 bounded, but do not integrate it yet as full schema/parser-language equivalence. Lane 02 should add semantic member-reference validation that reuses parse_immutable_ref (or an exactly equivalent shared validator) and field-kind checks, with invalid-UTF-8 and non-NFC regressions for logical-id and version components. Avoid encoding full Unicode validity/NFC semantics as an ever-growing duplicated regex if a shared parser-backed contract check can preserve one source of truth.
